'''Jeffrey''' ('''Jeff''') '''Demarco Teague''' (born June 10, 1988 in [[Indianapolis, Indiana]]) is a [[United States|American]] [[college basketball]] player for [[Wake Forest University]] in [[Winston-Salem, North Carolina]].  He played in high school for [[Pike High School|Pike High]].  Jeff is the cousin of David Teague who played for [[Purdue_Boilermakers_men's_basketball|Purdue University]].  He is known for his shooting ability and ability to drive to the basket.<ref name=chadford>[http://sports.espn.go.com/nba/draft2009/columns/story?columnist=ford_chad&page=FordDraftWatch-090115 Draft Watch: Getting to the point]</ref> As a freshman in 2007-08, he was 2nd on the team in scoring, scoring 13.9 points per game, just behind fellow freshman [[James Johnson (basketball)|James Johnson]]'s 14.6.<ref>[http://sports.espn.go.com/ncb/teams/stats?teamId=154&year=2008 Wake Forest Demon Deacons Statistics - 2007-08]</ref>  Teague is currently the leading scorer for the 4th ranked (as of January 26, 2009) Demon Deacons, averaging over 21 points per game.

Teague scored a career-high 34 points on January 11, 2009 in a 92-89 victory over [[North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball|North Carolina]].<ref>[http://sports.espn.go.com/ncb/recap?gameId=290110154 Demon Deacons limit Tar Heels to 35 percent shooting to remain unbeaten]</ref>

On April 8, 2009, Teague announced that he plans to forgo his final two seasons at [[Wake Forest University]] and make himself available for the [[2009 NBA Draft]], where he is a probable first round selection.
